mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_account (asset_type, owner_code, institution_code, account_name, account_number, current_balance_krw, currency_code, status, kis_linked, start_date, maturity_date, interest_rate, monthly_amount, payment_day, withdrawal_account_id, deposit_krw, deposit_usd, exchange_rate, last_synced_at) VALUES (#{assetType}, #{ownerCode}, #{institutionCode}, #{accountName}, #{accountNumber}, #{currentBalanceKrw}, #{currencyCode}, #{status}, #{kisLinked}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{interestRate}, #{monthlyAmount}, #{paymentDay}, #{withdrawalAccountId}, #{depositKrw}, #{depositUsd}, #{exchangeRate}, #{lastSyncedAt})
